title: Defer Deliberate Execution Grant
summary: Record the deliberate decision not to grant execution authority at this point, despite the FP-MCP-209 fresh preparation cycle having request, approval, pre-start evidence, state snapshots, and audited tooling in place. The decision is a real deferral: do not let preparation momentum substitute for a deliberate execution grant.
caveats: This is not a vague pause and not an implicit denial forever; it is a deliberate deferral of the execution grant decision.
The fresh FP-MCP-211 approval evidence was intentionally short-lived and must not be assumed usable after its expiry window.

The long session included tooling additions, ledger accounting repair, and a retroactive FP-MCP-194 tool-surface audit; crossing into execution immediately after that would risk momentum substituting for a fresh grant decision.
A future execution attempt requires a new explicit grant decision and, if the existing approval is expired, fresh scoped approval evidence bound to the then-current request/commit tuple.

The unresolved OpenAI invocation-layer trigger remains operationally characterized but internally unconfirmed; this is not itself a ForgePilot execution blocker, but it is part of the reason to avoid rushing the first guarded execution attempt at the end of a long session.

primaryReasons: The deliberate execution grant is a human/operator-level boundary and should not be crossed merely because all preparatory gates have been staged.
The approval evidence was deliberately short-lived and should not be assumed live for a later execution decision.
The session included multiple tooling and ledger-accounting corrections; a fresh execution decision should happen from a clean orientation rather than at the end of accumulated momentum.
secondaryReasons: The OpenAI invocation-layer trigger is operationally characterized but internally unconfirmed; it has been handled correctly as outside ForgePilot pipeline state, but it remains a caution against rushing.
A clean future grant packet can explicitly rebind any fresh approval, request, and commit tuple before FP-027.

futureResumeConditions: Re-orient with forgepilot_get_execution_gate_orientation using the execution packet id.
Verify current repository commit and request/approval freshness.
If approval expired or commit moved, create fresh scoped approval evidence and/or fresh request artifact as required.
Record a new explicit grant packet only if the operator deliberately authorizes one bounded attempt.
Run FP-027 with no retry, no chaining, process-tree snapshot before, explicit contact confirmation, and abort-readiness available.
